summary: The agreements include procurement deals for drilling equipment and oil country tubular goods

The agreements include procurement deals for drilling equipment and oil country tubular goods

Ruchika Khanna | Reuters News

World's top oil exporter Saudi Aramco has signed agreements with some French companies potentially worth over $3.7 billion in total, it said on Monday.

The agreements include procurement deals for drilling equipment and oil country tubular goods, as well as a memorandum of understanding to explore industrial AI and related technologies.

The company did not identify the French companies involved in the agreements.

(Reporting by Ruchika Khanna in Bengaluru Editing by Tomasz Janowski)
